collection_notes: Identity: all items are from Bonamici's official House site, campaign site, or House Clerk, for the OR-01 incumbent. Gaps: searches for cost-of-living, addiction, wildfire, infrastructure and civil rights returned only old or off-topic results, not fetched for lack of a usable 2025-2026 item. Item 'water' is dated 2021 (older). Campaign priorities page lists headings only, no detail. Some sources (Pamplin 2024 addiction groundbreaking) lacked a usable quote and were not used.
